content: 3:1-9 Sios munon eng wuri Qenu wonou wau unebi

Io, an yonou munon banam, gigit ye qob aninob qamam eng an Igomurur qau anboopuri igama qob aninob qamarau gas ende ue. Qen end an munon ar qomon ag toat igamari animbag qob aninob qamamei. Qen end an wau ber gas ende, Yisas qomon eng musub me imbigau.
Ye wau unor inau utau gas ende at igumei. Mani gagam me andarau. Qen end an me nonoguretarau, eng gas ende see gor ende igoumon.
See gor an munangit qomon end igoumon. Igo qimerimot qiyo a aguniau qomon eng me boopur wagau, ten igoumon. Qomon eng gagar ebet igoumon eng munangit wurinou qomon qoan eng.
Ende at ne ger der, “Ye Pol wonou yurau” qamb, ne ger bo der, “Ye Apolos wonou yurau” qamb ebet igoumon end an munangit qomon eng toat igoumon.

Eng at igoumon end an musub imbig gaiar. Your eng Apolos, ne ye Pol eng ye your? In ombur in Qenu wonou sarau munon gari. In ombur sarau wes-wes abar qamb inimbigor end ubune an Munon Aibt oabig igoumon eng.
Ye mi niau qur gunine ne Apolos wo qaur di gegereteriner qamb ya wot igi igo. Ne Qenu musia di igo.
End ne munon mani ubub igo eng nob ya wot igi igo eng nob ombur wuri abari mi uber me di igo. Qenu wonou gari mi musia di arit igo.
Munon mi ubub igo eng nob ya wot igi igo eng nob ombur wuri qeemben gari. Qenu wurinou sarau taui mi qeemben werisiba.
An Qenu wonou man gas ende igamari in ombur Qenu wonou mani obotau gas ende at igoun. Ne gor an Qenu wonou mon mindaterei gas ende.
3:10-15 Sios munon wuri munai mindau qoyam imbi-imbi
Qenu wonou uyes yetoubetar end ye munon mon mindau qoyam imbi-imbi gas ende. End ne ye qoren qamar yimine munon ger mon dagariamorei. End ne munon gari-gari mom qoyamet mon dagariomunor.
Qenu wo qoren unotari qo yamor eng Munon inubersiau tari Yisas. Munon ger bo sabar qoren unatari me yiminerei.
Qenu qoren yamor erer end munon qei mon mindaub eng mai qei nam ningirim qiyo yember qiyo, qouiom qiyo. Ne qei arur qiyo a mogorumb qiyo, tub isur eng gagar ba mon dagari igour.

Munon gugum mon eng at mindat igour eng qen sindomund end dibenara wuriqereimba. Qereimau qen end mut nanau ten darimba. Nanau eng munon wurinou qomon gari-gari eng wuriqerei ne ba dibesia wurinou sarau uber ebet igurei qiyo boru qiyo eng diban gubour.
Munon ger qoren erer end mon mindat igama mut oab mon eng me oeiner eng taui mi baiba.
Ne sarau munon ger wonou mon oab uburiner eng wo ar qer uter wab wegiba. Ne wo git ar uber igoriner eng munon mut oa bo ineri baiau gas ende.
3:16-17 In Qenu wonou munai qoregen
Aninou git goan eng Qenu wonou munai qau. Wonou Igomurur an erobon end igo.
End ne munon ger Qenu wonou munai eng ba sumungasieriner eng wo gor munon eng sumungasieriba. An Qenu wonou munai qau, end ne an git goan eng wonou munai mor.
3:18-23 Munon qei unum me ba ereriomun
Munon ger wonou misirt ete qemeriner eng: “Ye qoyam imbi-imbi, munon gugum wuritanamimoum.” Munon ger ende qamb gab eng wo unum me bererieminer. Qi igo ne wo sig-sig mom qoyam imbi-imbi igoriba.
Munangit qoyam eng Qenu gar eng munon qanganget igo gas ende. End Qenu qob ete igo: “Munon qei in qoyam imbi-imbi qamb igorunor eng qib igamari Qenu qemi imot igama wuribeiba.”
Ne qob ger ete qura:

content.text: “Munangit in qoyam imbi-imbi qamb ebet igour eng Munon Aib ibagar eng mi ue gas ende.”
End ne munon ger igo in munangit oboun eng gab in unum me bererieminer. Eng an igamari mi gugum anonogursi igo.
Pol ne Apolos ne Pita, ne ai, ne igom igamau eng, ne umau eng, ne mi gugum see igour eng, ne bo qen geret diorunor eng gugum aninou.
Ne gor an git goan eng Munon inubersiau tari eng wonou. Ne Munon inubersiau tari eng Qenu wonou.
